protocol.timing: forward+cross-entropy+backward+Adam update; allocation/clones/GC/initial optimizer state excluded; hooks absent in timing runs
protocol.memory: unique live observable CPU tensor storage, includes input, labels, weights, gradients, Adam state and operator outputs; excludes immutable fixtures/runtime/native operator scratch; not RSS/GPU VRAM
protocol.attention: PyTorch CPU scaled-dot-product attention, causal; same API for both models; explicit scale head_width**-.5
protocol.llt: fixed shared global KV latent from initial input; full residual state; differentiable query/output folding outside loops; exact autograd
protocol.lla: paper is post-training inference cache codec; no native LLA pretraining memory graph claimed; parent teacher training follows naive graph
protocol.checkpoint: non-reentrant PyTorch exact checkpointing; identical options for both models
protocol.quality: random weights/token targets; gradient correctness only, no learned quality comparison

folding_validation.reference: explicit full K/V and masked-softmax attention, unfolded projections
